decisions.reason: As a certified plate heat exchanger line close to the core business, it fits existing capabilities and channels, and with no clear sign of underperformance a growing, innovative firm would likely retain it while results accumulate.
The product already shows a strong positive market signal through its stated major market share in marine water cooling, placing it comfortably above aspiration and making withdrawal very unlikely.

Although evidence is still limited, the marine cooling unit builds directly on established marine cooling know-how, and available organizational slack makes continued market presence more likely than early abandonment.
The compact oil cooler is an adjacent product line that can use the firm’s engineering, manufacturing, and service base, so absent negative feedback management would normally keep it on the market.
Finned tubes for air coolers are somewhat more component-like and may face more uncertainty, but they still leverage the firm’s exchanger expertise and would likely be kept while learning continues.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes align with the firm’s R&D-oriented improvement path and installed-base knowledge, so a boundedly rational management would usually continue rather than drop them after such a short market period.
